dtNote: Effective dt per N is gap-seeded: dtEff = min(DT, d_min^2/80). See row.dt for actual dt used (imp514d fix).

rows.note: Float64 RK4 (NOT certified). dt gap-seeded: initialMinGap=3.770e-2, dtEff=1.776e-5 (imp514d fix). Estimated ~0s/step. Collision detected at t_c ~ 0.000300.

subGaps.description: zeros data blocker: zeros-to-1e6.js has 100K entries; N>100K needs zeros2..zerosK. Run this script with --download to fetch additional Odlyzko batches. zeros6 may also be a combined 2M-zero file (~35 MB) at the same base URL.

compute feasibility: Float64 RK4 in Node.js handles N up to ~250K-400K (minutes to hours). N=600K-1M requires C/Rust backend (Arb, CAPD, or custom). This script cannot fully close imp-514 for N=1M without native code.

certification: Float64 RK4 gives t_c central value without error bars. Interval arithmetic (interval-dyson-integrator.mjs) is certified but returns budget-exhausted for N>100K. Closing imp-514 with certified bounds at N=1M requires a native Arb/CAPD backend.

step-size overshoot at large N: FIXED (two-stage). Stage 1 (initial overshoot, prior run): dtEff = min(DT, d_min^2/80) is seeded from the initial minimum gap d_min so the first RK4 step cannot overshoot the nearest-pair collapse time T_pair ~ d_min^2/8. Stage 2 (dt-restoration bug, this run): backwardCollisionRK4Float64 now accepts maxDt=DT so the integrator restores currentDt to the original DT (not to dtEff) once mg > 10 * ADAPT_THRESH. Previously, restoration returned to dtEff (e.g. 2.70e-6 at N=150K), keeping the step permanently tiny and covering only stepsEff * dtEff = 300 * 2.70e-6 = 8.1e-4 of the ~0.00668 integration range. With the fix, the integrator recovers to DT=0.0001 after the initial close-pair zone, covering 300 total steps including ~250 at DT=0.0001 => 0.025 time units >> OLS(150K)=0.00668. Wall time is unchanged (~7 hr at N=150K in JS), but the run now returns a meaningful t_c instead of budget-exhausted at t=0.00081.

usageNote: Import these rows into dyson-ladder-measured.js to replace PROJECTED_ROWS at matching N. Only rows with source="measured-float64-rk4" and reason="gap-nonpositive" carry a meaningful collision time. Budget-exhausted rows report t_c as a lower bound.
